summary: Phase 42-D Polish Bundle (D1 thumbnails / D2 trial+vouchers / D3 station favorites) tested end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass; frontend smoke (landing strip + /radio cards + heart toggle + favorites flyout + /personas entitlement + /billing voucher section) all confirmed working.

minor.issue: Eligibility check ordering: when max_redemptions=1 and the SAME user reuses the code, the exhaustion check (410 voucher_exhausted) fires before the per-user reuse guard (409 voucher_already_redeemed). To reliably surface the 409 path, max_redemptions must be > current redemptions_count. Not blocking — task spec actually maps these to the correct paths — but worth noting if the frontend ever issues max=1 codes and expects 409 on same-user retry.

issues: React console warning: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' — non-blocking but worth a code review.
Hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' inside [data-testid=shell-desktop] — non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Consider re-ordering checks in /api/subscriptions/redeem-voucher to evaluate per-user reuse before exhaustion so same-user retry on max=1 vouchers returns the more informative 409 'voucher_already_redeemed' instead of 410 'voucher_exhausted'.
(Cleanup) Address nested <button> hydration warning in shell-desktop and the 'key in spread props' React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: billing_trial.py: structured state response is correct — 4 branches (already_active/already_consumed/upgrade_required/started) each return 200 with is_premium_or_trial flag. Good.
admin_subscriptions.py: voucher code generator uses secrets.choice (cryptographically secure) and stores uppercased with unique index — correct.

subscription_voucher.py: idempotency on insert via unique compound index (voucher_id, user_id). Order of guards: revoked → expired → exhausted → per-user-reuse. Consider swapping the last two if you want 409 to surface on max=1 same-user retry.
station_favorites.py: compound unique (user_id, station_id) makes POST idempotent. GET batches channel + imported lookups in two queries — efficient. MongoDB _id is popped from response — clean.
All 4 channel_thumbnails .webp files return 200 (bollywood_mehfil, vip_lounge, party_dubai, late_night_drive). party_dubai → party_dubai.webp fix confirmed (no party_mix.webp 404).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke-tested flows (landing tiles, /radio bigfm_ai cards, heart toggle, favorites flyout, /personas entitlement, /billing voucher section)
